articles.title: Looking for an Investment Uncorrelated With War or Oil? Consider These Spinoffs.
articles.mainIdea: Looking for an Investment Uncorrelated With War or Oil? Consider These Spinoffs.
articles.summary: Barrons.com: Looking for an Investment Uncorrelated With War or Oil? Consider These Spinoffs.. Spinoffs can fit that bill. Trivariate Research founder Adam Parker published his “Spinoff Playbook” on Tuesday, providing context on the performance of stocks that start a new life away from their parent company. After the deal is done, spinoffs generally outperform the parents, but it can take about six months for things to start improving. Related tickers mentioned: CL=F, HON.
